info.title: API.SH: AliExpress
info.description: The AliExpress API from API.SH: public AliExpress data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
AliExpress sometimes answers with a verification check instead of the item; the call tries again by itself (up to 3 times) before answering.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aliexpress-product

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: Destination country (default US): prices, shipping options and delivery times for it. AliExpress words the product in that market's language (DE in German, JP in Japanese...).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the prices, e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY (default USD).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language (es, fr, de, it, pt, ru, nl, pl, tr, ko, ja, ar, he, th, vi, id): the product in that language, priced and shipped for its market. Leave out with ship_to.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` back as `page`. `next_page` is null when the page is short. `filter` (or `with_photos=true`) narrows to reviews with photos, from the reviewer's own country (`local`) or with a follow-up review; `country` and `language` pick the review set and translation the site shows a shopper there. The response echoes `filter`, `country` and `language`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aliexpress-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Item URL or product id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: all (default), with_photos, local (reviews from the shopper's country), additional (with a follow-up review).

parameters.name: with_photos
parameters.description: true: same as filter=with_photos.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shopper country code (default US).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language / translation (default en): en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ru, nl, pl, tr, ko, ja, ar, he, th, vi, id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` back as `page`. `next_page` is null when the page is short. `ship_to`, `currency` and `lang` show prices, shipping and titles as a shopper in that country with that currency and language sees them; `category_id` keeps results to one category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aliexpress-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: orders: best-selling first.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the response currency (USD by default).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, in the response currency (USD by default).

parameters.name: ship_from
parameters.description: Only items shipping from this country (US, CN, ES, FR, DE…).

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: Ask AliExpress for free-shipping items (applied by AliExpress, best effort).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only this AliExpress category (its numeric id, as in category links).

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: Destination country code (default US): prices and delivery for shoppers there.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for prices (default USD), e.g. EUR, GBP.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of titles (default en): en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ru, nl, pl, tr, ko, ja, ar, he, th, vi, id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
